answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fakes. Each agent enters through one inlet, posting a 500 POA bond listed in an atlas. It decays 5% per epoch without verified work; a beacon broadcasts renewal deadlines, and expired bonds drop off the atlas. Forging 100 identities costs 50,000 POA plus 2,500 POA per epoch in decay, and fakes earn nothing once bonds lapse. An honest agent pays one bond once, renews it by working, and keeps its undiluted share.
